text.p: Jakks Pacific Inc said it is reducing the size of its public offering to 600,000 shares, from two million originally planned.
It said it has also registered 90,000 shares of common stock to be sold by two stockholders in the event the overallotment option is exercised.

Jakks said it expects proceeds from the reduced offering to total about $2.9 million, after commissions and expenses are paid. Of that amount, about $1 million will be used to repay short-term debt, about $500,000 will be used to acquire character and product licenses for new toy products, and another $1 million will be used to acquire product lines and other toy businesses. The remaining $400,000 will be added to working capital for for general corporate purposes, Jakks said.

The company had originally expected proceeds of $14.2 million from the $2 million share offering but said it still believes its cash flow from operations, cash on hand and proceeds from the 600,000 share offering will be sufficient to meet working capital requirements.
